raw:
I chose 10 focal edits that probe the structurally important edges, such as the conv or skip on edge 3 and removals on edges 0, 3, 4 and 5. I applied each edit to a shared panel of 12 diverse parents: uniform cells (all conv3, all skip, all avg, all conv1) and mixed cells with different edges set to none or skip. Because every edit sees the same parents, comparing results across parents shows which parent-edge conditions change an edit's effect. I left out any edit that would not change the parent cell. Three extra edge-2 removals bring the total to exactly 100.
